detections.title: Root policy attachment
detections.query: any where cloud.provider:"aws" and user.name:"root" and event.action in ("AttachUserPolicy", "PutUserPolicy", "AttachRolePolicy", "PutRolePolicy")
detections.description: A root principal attached or changed a policy. Root should not be doing routine IAM administration.
detections.detection_change: Alert on any root policy change, require a break-glass ticket, and export the finding to Apsis so the graph shows the new reachable paths.

detections.title: Root user creation
detections.query: any where cloud.provider:"aws" and user.name:"root" and event.action:"CreateUser"
detections.description: A root principal created a new IAM user. That user is a persistence candidate and needs immediate review.
detections.detection_change: Alert on root-created IAM users, disable the new principal pending review, and add it to the Apsis inventory.

detections.title: CloudTrail tampering
detections.query: any where cloud.provider:"aws" and event.action in ("StopLogging", "DeleteTrail", "UpdateTrail")
detections.description: A principal stopped, deleted, or changed a CloudTrail trail. This is a defense-evasion lead and a visibility emergency.
detections.detection_change: Alert on trail changes, verify the trail with an independent account-level control, and require a change ticket.
